import numpy as np
import scipy.sparse as sp
import networkx as nx
import pennylane as qml
import pennylane.numpy as np
from pennylane.qchem import qaoa
from pennylane.qchem.qaoa import QAOAChemistryProblem, QAOASolver

def adjacency_matrix(graph_vertices, graph_edges):
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(graph_edges)
    A = nx.adj_matrix(G).toarray()
    return A

def solve_graph_partition_qaoa(graph_vertices, graph_edges, known_reference_partition=None, p_layers=1, lambda_balance=1.0, lambda_cut=3.0, opt_shots=256, final_shots=1024, maxiter=30, n_repro_runs=3, seed=42):
    A = adjacency_matrix(graph_vertices, graph_edges)
    Q = QAOAChemistryProblem(A, num_qubits=len(graph_vertices), num_electrons=None, spin_multiplicity=None, n_layers=p_layers, coupling_map=None)
    solver = QAOASolver(Q, min_obj=lambda_balance*Q.obj_func_minimum, maxiter=maxiter, opt_shots=opt_shots, final_shots=final_shots, n_repetitions=n_repro_runs, seed=seed)
    initial_state = qml.qaoa.MinimumEigenstate(Q.num_qubits, p_layers)
    parameters = solver. solve(initial_state, return_intermediate=True)
    if known_reference_partition:
        modularity_score = Q.modularity(known_reference_partition)
        normalized_cut_score = Q.normalized_cut(known_reference_partition)
        balance_constraint_score = Q.balance_constraint(parameters)
        approximation_ratio = Q.approximation_ratio(parameters)
        return {
            "modularity_score": modularity_score,
            "normalized_cut_score": normalized_cut_score,
            "balance_constraint_score": balance_constraint_score,
            "approximation_ratio": approximation_ratio,
            "runtime": solver.runtime,
            "reproducibility": solver.reproducibility
        }
    else:
        G_part = Q.partition(parameters)
        modularity_score = Q.modularity(G_part)
        normalized_cut_score = Q.normalized_cut(G_part)
        balance_constraint_score = Q.balance_constraint(parameters)
        approximation_ratio = Q.approximation_ratio(parameters)
        return {
            "modularity_score": modularity_score,
            "normalized_cut_score": normalized_cut_score,
            "balance_constraint_score": balance_constraint_score,
            "approximation_ratio": approximation_ratio,
            "runtime": solver.runtime,
            "reproducibility": solver.reproducibility
        }
